text_block_list.text:
One day, after training and picking up a
few
things in the shopping district...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There appears to be a raffle stand over
here.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect to receive a raffle ticket
along
with my notebook purchase...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Do you have time in your schedule?

text_block_list.text:
If we increase our walking speed back
home,
there should be no problem.
Above all...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I cannot miss this opportunity for an
interesting
story to tell my parents.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'm excited to see what this Japanese
way of
testing luck in a raffle has in store
for me.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: What's got your eye, young lady?
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
If we consider what prize would be
equivalent in
value with my notebook,
then I suppose it would
be the single
carrot.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Really?! I don't see many folks like you,
that's for
sure!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
I believe luck tests like this are more
about
enjoying the experience than the
prize. Now, here
I go.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш gives the tumbler a spin with
a tense
expression on her face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The hot spring vacation!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Wahnsinn!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thank you... But is this acceptable?
Should I
really take it?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that luck smiled on you today
because
you're so humble. Don't just
throw that luck away!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
You're right. I gratefully accept this,
then.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Hot springs...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I do. In fact, Germany is just as
renowned for its
hot springs as Japan.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The temperature is lower than those
here, so it's
possible to spend an entire
day relaxing in the
bath.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I haven't had an
opportunity to
visit one since arriving in
Japan.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: So... I'm genuinely happy for this.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
It'll be nice to take it easy and soak in one,
then.

text_block_list.text: Take it easy...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, may I entrust you with the
coupon?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Alas, there is no room in my schedule for
a hot
spring getaway at present.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Let me think... After everything is
finished next
year, I should have enough
leeway to go.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
That said, I cannot write it into my
schedule in
orange ink as I am now.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Therefore, could you give it back to me
once
everything has concluded?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And that's how the hot spring vacation
ticket
came into my possession.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: By the way, why orange ink specifically?

text_block_list.text:
When it is for something I am looking
forward to
in my schedule, I write it in
orange.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Is that part of German culture?

text_block_list.text:
No, it is but a habit of mine from early
childhood.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I can tell you are laughing. Is orange a
strange
color?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
No, I just think it's cute how you color code
your schedule.

text_block_list.text:
Please give it a try for yourself
sometime. You'll
come to understand
how rational this conscious
decision is
once you do.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You must understand—schedules are
meant to be
written in minute detail. By
categorizing
everything with colors, the
information—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It looks more delicious than I expected...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But of course. The dish originated from
Germany,
after all!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I feel entitled to critique the
flavor.
Let's find out if it is worthy of
being called a
"deluxe" hamburger
steak.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: A few days later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Munch, munch...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: ...It is delicious!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...This is truth in advertising, I see. How
many
kilograms is this, exactly?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Beats me... All I know is the box is
jam-packed, so
your guess is as good as
mine.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
They completely disregarded their profit
margins
with these prizes. Well, I must
reciprocate that
goodwill.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I know just what to do. I shall make
Rüblitorte
with these.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
A delicious Swiss carrot cake. The flavor
of carrot
in it is rich and scrumptious.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
My parents taught me a recipe for it
which
doesn't require butter.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
However, we cannot possibly eat it all
ourselves.
So to remedy that...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Flash, the oven's all ready! ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
The batter is also complete. Let's bake
four whole
cakes at a time.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Just what I wanted. What a great result.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You sure are one in a million, young
lady...
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, but do you know any good
recipes for
this carrot?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
At the moment, I cannot think of one
which would
use it in its entirety.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Oh! My ma will know for sure! HEEEY,
MAAA!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text: What? Please, you needn't go so far—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I heard your question, no worries!
You want
to whip up something nice
with that carrot, don't
you?
text_block_list.name: Female Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
I just happened to have put a little
something
together earlier, so why don't
you come on back
and have a taste of
it?
text_block_list.name: Female Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text: Wh-what?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
As they say, experience is the best
teacher.
Right? Hahaha!
text_block_list.name: Female Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text: What should I do, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
...Very well. I look forward to your...
lesson?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What a Pechvogel I am...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: It means "an unlucky person."
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Winning a consolation prize was well
within the
realm of possibility.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Yet despite understanding that fully...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And so, Эйсин Флэш receives a heartfelt
cooking
lesson from the nice lady.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She gives Japan's hamburger steaks a
perfect
score.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Эйсин Флэш's lecture on the finer
points of
schedule-making lasts all the
way home.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Understanding something and accepting

something is very different. Эйсин Флэш
is clearly
disappointed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Sometime later, Эйсин Флэш bakes and
shares a
bunch of cakes with her
dormmates—and they
rave about it for
days afterward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
